mission: Leap 2 - Smart Factory: Phase 1 Composable Command Library

tasks.title: Spec: Command JSON Schema
tasks.description: Define composable command DSL with JSON schema validation. Schema must support Spec/Code/Test task types, dependency resolution, tier assignment, and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Schema validates 10 example commands without errors
Supports Spec/Code/Test task types with enum validation
Documents tier assignment rules (Tier 1 vs Tier 2)
Defines acceptance criteria format for Spec tasks

tasks.title: Implement TaskGraph Pydantic Model
tasks.description: Create shared/models/task_graph.py with TaskGraph, Phase, Task, Checkpoint Pydantic models. Include validators for Code→Test dependencies, DAG validation, and memory budget checks.

tasks.title: Test TaskGraph Validation
tasks.description: AAA tests for TaskGraph validation: happy path (valid graphs), edge cases (circular deps, missing deps, Code without Test), and constitutional violations.

tasks.title: Spec: Parallel Execution Strategy
tasks.description: Define parallel execution strategy with topological sort, memory-aware worker limits (3 max with local model), and constitutional compliance checks at each layer.
acceptance_criteria: Topological sort algorithm specified with time complexity O(V+E)
Memory-aware worker calculation documented (Article II Section 2.4)
Error handling strategy for task failures defined

tasks.title: Implement Topological Sort
tasks.description: Add topological_sort() method to TaskGraph that returns list of parallelizable layers. Use Kahn's algorithm or DFS-based approach.

tasks.title: Test Topological Sort
tasks.description: Test topological sort with linear graph (sequential), parallel graph (independent tasks), and mixed dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement Parallel Executor
tasks.description: Create execute_task_graph() function with asyncio.gather for parallel execution, memory-aware worker limits, and error handling with user retry/skip/abort prompts.

tasks.title: Test Parallel Executor
tasks.description: Integration tests for parallel executor: verify correct layer execution order, memory budget enforcement, and error handling with mock tasks.

tasks.title: Implement Mermaid DAG Renderer
tasks.description: Add to_mermaid() method to TaskGraph that generates Mermaid diagram with phase subgraphs, tier-based styling, and dependency edges.

tasks.title: Test Mermaid Renderer
tasks.description: Verify Mermaid output is valid syntax, includes all tasks and edges, and applies correct styling classes.

checkpoints.prompt: Review TaskGraph Pydantic models and JSON schema before implementing DAG scheduler. Verify Code→Test dependencies validation is working.
Review parallel execution strategy and memory-aware worker limits. Test with example mission graph before visualization phase.
